verdict.rationale: Viam documents a built-in data manager that captures component output on the machine and syncs it to the Viam cloud. Data queues locally during outages and in low-bandwidth environments, then syncs when connectivity returns, with restarts and storage constraints handled automatically. That covers on-robot capture and resilient sync, but the 'bandwidth-aware' part appears only as automatic queuing behavior, not as configurable policies. Missing for 10: documented configurable sync policies (intervals, throttling, prioritization or filtering by bandwidth), per-resource capture frequency settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture sensor and telemetry data on-robot and sync it to the cloud with bandwidth-aware policies
